title: Delete TOU Exception
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
You can toggle between the status Active and Inactive by selecting one or more lines and choosing |}*Edit + Change Activation
Status “Jin the menu. When you change the status, the system checks in the BAd| ISU TOUEXCEPT STATUS, method
CHECK_CHANGE ACTIVATION STATUS whether the TOU exception has already been billed. If billing has been performed for the
TOU exception, you can no longer change the activation status.

Delete TOU Exception
You can only delete a TOU exception if it has not yet been billed.

Enhancements

You can use the enhancement spot ISU TOUEXCEPTION to define enhancements.

1 Note
Note that the report RETOUEXCEPTION DISP_MAINT is only intended for manual corrections on a small scale.

Archiving of Time-of-Use Exceptions

Use

You can use archiving to store time-of-use (TOU) exceptions so that you can view and use them when required.

Prerequisites

The possible prerequisites for the different archiving steps are described below in the detailed description for the individual
process phases.

Features

The archiving process for TOU exceptions consists of the following steps:

1. Analysis of TOU exceptions with regard to potential archiving.
2. Archive the TOU exceptions selected in the first step.

3. Delete TOU exceptions from the database on the basis of the previously created archive.

4. Optional reloading of archived and deleted data.

1 Note

Note that you cannot reload individual TOU exceptions, but must always reload the entire archiving run. This procedure
should not normally be used and should be limited to extreme problem cases (for example, incorrect retention period in
Customizing).

5. Optional reading of TOU exceptions from the archive and output in a list before the deletion process.

1. Analysis of Archivability of TOU Exceptions (report REAARCH_ANALYSE_EXCEPT)
